0.7.8: Linux installs on every distribution, Rune runs through a loader, tmux colours are right, and web_fetch can carry cookies.
0.8.0: Twenty model presets, on the older, quieter preset pattern.
0.8.1: The session picker's caret is 1-based, so it no longer lands on the wrong row.
0.8.9: Submitting, compaction and the order of sessions are fixed.
0.9.0: A submitted message is acknowledged, and a session resumes after a restart.
0.9.1: Work is planned from the context at hand, and thinking can be switched off or set low through a model gateway.
0.9.2: Copying and selecting with the mouse works as it does elsewhere, including Clear.
0.9.3: A command you run yourself with ! behaves like the rest of the session, and its links can be opened.
0.9.4: A multi-line shell script is previewed honestly, and a ! command keeps its context.
0.9.5: The output of a running or waiting process is written to its own log.
0.9.6: The composer previews one line, and the prompt streams as you type.
0.9.7: The composer previews an explicit newline instead of raw line breaks in the source.
0.9.8: Context counts stay honest: an unknown size is never guessed.
0.9.9: One owner per instruction block, and the footer keeps Esc, retry and the confirmation.
0.10.0: A live update notice stays visible in the session view.
0.10.1: Installing the official help can no longer shadow or overwrite your own skills.
0.10.3: Terminal output no longer counts the input lines it echoes, and tool actions keep their descriptions.
0.10.4: Logs show the original error text, and identical calls made three or six times are flagged.
0.10.5: A repetition warning now says what to do about it.
0.10.6: Tool results stay pure, and a call repeated in one turn is named in the conversation.
0.10.7: Long answers are no longer cut short through a model gateway.
0.10.9: Project memory says what it is for, tool arguments accept aliases, and a wrong path gets a closer suggestion.
0.10.10: Clearer instructions about waiting for background work, file paths and patch staleness.
0.11.0: An empty response header no longer appears when streamed text holds only whitespace.
0.11.1: A reply that repeats one exact unit is stopped while it streams, and you keep or discard the text.
0.11.2: An intermediate answer no longer leaves a gap before the next step.
0.11.3: One tool types into or stops a background task in place of two older tools, and a finished task reports itself with its own output.
0.11.4: Fixes found while auditing background tasks and their notifications.
0.11.5: The first-start help screen no longer races a slow start, and Windows paths ending in a space or a dot are handled.
0.11.6: The elevation wording on the ! screen.
0.11.7: Reasoning streams before the answer, so a reply is no longer split in the middle, and thought blocks are joined per round.
0.11.8: Changing the permission mode while a reply streams no longer makes the footer reflow, and a status notice you are reading is no longer cleared by it.
